```python
# Simulated pipeline test (conceptual)
import json, os

def test_pipeline(tick: int) -> dict:
    """Verify solver pipeline at a given tick."""
    problem = {
        "problem_class": f"off-by-one-self-test-2026-07-30-tick{tick}",
        "environment": "",
        "language": "",
        "description": f"Self-test: verify solver pipeline end-to-end at tick {tick}"
    }
    # Output files
    output = "/tmp/test_solution.md"
    evidence = "/tmp/test_evidence.md"
    signatures = "/tmp/test_signatures.json"
    
    # Invoke the pipeline
    ret = os.system(
        f"pi-agent solve "
        f"--problem-file <(echo '{json.dumps(problem)}') "
        f"--output {output} --evidence {evidence} --signatures {signatures} "
        f"--model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash"
    )
    assert ret == 0, "Pipeline invocation failed"
    
    # Verify all outputs exist
    assert os.path.exists(output), "Solution missing"
    assert os.path.exists(evidence), "Evidence missing"
    assert os.path.exists(signatures), "Signatures missing"
    
    # Verify signatures JSON is valid
    with open(signatures) as f:
        sig = json.load(f)
    assert sig["problem_class"] == problem["problem_class"]
    
    return sig

# Run at tick 214
result = test_pipeline(214)
assert result["result"] == "passed"
```
